summary.zh: 为并行分支或 Agent 建独立工作树
summary.en: Give each branch or agent its own worktree, then clean up stale ones.

description.zh: 同时开多条分支或多个任务时，为每条分支建立独立 worktree，分配不同端口和环境变量，避免相互干扰，用完清理失效目录。适合并行开发和多个 Agent 改同一个仓库。需要在仓库目录内执行。
description.en: Creates a worktree per branch with its own ports and environment variables so parallel work stops colliding, and removes stale ones. Suited to parallel development and several agents on one repo. Run it inside the repository.
